adjudication.rationale: In `packages/core/EventManager.ts` within `createAllCalendarEvents`, the new logic iterates `event.destinationCalendar` and, when `destination.credentialId` is not found in `this.calendarCredentials`, it fetches a credential directly from the DB via `prisma.credential.findUnique({ where: { id: destination.credentialId } })` and then uses it to `createEvent(...)`. The diff shows no authorization/ownership check that the fetched credential belongs to an expected user (e.g., organizer/host/team member) before using its `key` to write calendar events, so if a `destination.credentialId` can be influenced or becomes inconsistent, calendar writes could run under an arbitrary credential id.
